cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish this booking. I'll put the review on tomorrow's calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cancel mine too. Shall we settle the cancellation before opening the missed-dinner complaint?

reason: Replace announced authority with calendar management and shared dessert cancellation; A still uses B solution to defer the personal explanation.
